scripts.dev:desktop: concurrently -k "npm run start:backend" "npm run start:frontend" "npm run start:electron-dev"
scripts.start:backend: cd backend && npx nodemon --watch . --ext ts,json --ignore uploads/** --ignore security/** --ignore node_modules/** --ignore test/** --exec "ts-node --preferTsExts" index.ts
scripts.start:electron-dev: wait-on tcp:3000 http://127.0.0.1:5173 && set ETECZKA_DEV_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173&& set ETECZKA_EXTERNAL_BACKEND=1&& electron .
